correctness.rationale: For the full 20-arc bidirected wheel C5*K1, independent two-method enumeration confirms 871 augmented faces with cardinalities (1,20,130,330,310,80). Newly computed mod-2 ranks (19,111,217,70) yield H2=2,H3=23,H4=10. Exact greedy Morse matching of 408 incidences including empty cell has residual critical 12 2-cells,33 3-cells and 10 4-cells; verified acyclicity and integer d3 of unit rank ten, d4=0. Independently reconstructed integer Morse chains, two rationally independent integral 2-cocycles and ten exact integral top 4-cycles, each with zero simplicial boundary; all 30 independent unordered cup evaluations are exactly zero. Algebraic unit cancellations give 3-skeleton ∨2 S² ∨23 S³. H2 diagonal and mixed Alexander–Whitney cup products annihilate its two Hopf and one Whitehead components of π3(∨2 S²), while d4 eliminates 3-sphere degrees; integral torsion-free π3 makes ten 4-cell maps null. Thus integral wedge ∨2 S2 ∨23 S3 ∨10 S4.
residual_risks: Exact finite homotopy deduction relies on the inspected acyclic matching and integer attaching-map chain/cup calculations, not only field Betti numbers.
